description: This file implements the 'Delete' feature for unfollowing a profile. It defines a command, validator, and request handler to remove a follower relationship between the current user and the specified username, handling potential errors and returning the updated profile information.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete an observer relationship with a user identified by Username.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Username parameter in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of the follower relationship by removing the FollowedPeople record linking observer and target, throwing errors if users are not found, and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to find the target user, verify current user, remove the follow relationship if exists, and return the updated profile.
